title: Buzkashi
tagline: Scoop the sack, round the post, ride into the circle.
description: Buzkashi is the team horse game of Afghanistan and Central Asia. See the field from above, ride with one finger, scoop the sack, round the post and strip it from rivals. Winter Cup, Gauntlet, Practice, Learn drills, Think hints and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Hold a finger where you want your rider to go.
Tap Grab near the loose sack, slowly, to scoop it.
Carry it round the post at the far end.
Ride into the white circle to score a carry.
Ride alongside a rival and tap Grab to strip the sack.
